sharingOwnerRules.description: All internal SFTS users get read/write on every Intake record. REQUIRED for the Intake auto-assignment Flow — without this, Lana (the new owner) lacks read permission on records created by the integration user, and the Flow's OwnerId transfer fails with TRANSFER_REQUIRES_READ. Matches the all-internal pattern used across all other SFTS custom objects.
sharingOwnerRules.label: All Internal Users RW
